crossRefs.note: Even all the nations will say, “Why has Yahweh done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”
Joshua said, “Alas, Lord Yahweh, why have you brought this people over the Jordan at all, to deliver us into the hand…
God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?
The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against Yahweh.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: They said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, why has this happened in Israel, that there should be one tribe lacking in Israel today?”
translations.bsb: “Why, O LORD God of Israel,” they cried out, “has this happened in Israel? Today in Israel one tribe is missing!”
translations.kjv: And said, O LORD God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel?
translations.asv: And they said, O Jehovah, the God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to-day one tribe lacking in Israel?
